title: EP02 wave 2 for rwb-partner while the service's Architecture v5 wave is 4
source: Architecture v5 slides 4, 5, 17 and 41; Template and Rules R5.6, R5.7 (W-MAP); TSD S9 T-A.1 (operation first-in E2 and E4)
description: The business epic EP02 maps to wave 2 under the W-MAP, and the service table places rwb-partner in wave 4. R5.6 keeps the earlier wave, so the EP02 portal slice of this key is scheduled two waves before the service baseline it belongs to.
evidence: Architecture v5 slides 4 and 5 place S9 Partner with Epics 6 and 7; the service table of R5.4 and the context pack give S9 wave 4; the W-MAP of R5.6 gives EP02 wave 2 and R5.7 says the earlier wave is kept with one conflict per service and business epic.
proposed: Keep wave 2 as the story wave, build against the wave 0 and wave 1 platform and P3/P4 contracts and their fakes, and let the service's own runtime baseline land in wave 4 as the architecture says.

title: The rwb-partner slice of the key has no published load path, no message per condition and no partner_user catalogue
source: TSD S9 T-A.1, T-A.2, T3.1; legacy RWB-E2-019 sections 3, 12 and 13; DL38; RWB-P4-E2019-CON
description: Four values of this slice have no source: the operation that loads a partner_user binding (TSD S9 T-A.1 lists API-S9-001 to API-S9-006 only and the legacy reference-load path is rwb-access's API-P4-005), the message id per refusal condition (T-A.2 gives status codes only), the field catalogue of partner_user (absent from TSD S9 T3.1) and the shape of the local record of a refusal at the owner. The refresh interval is only assumed with DL38.
evidence: TSD S9 T-A.1 lists six operations and none of them is a reference load; T-A.2 gives errors as codes 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422 and 503 with no message id; TSD S9 T3.1 has no partner_user object; the legacy story's partner_user fields come from the Logical Data Model DF-REF-212 to DF-REF-217; the legacy story marks rwb.access.membership-refresh-minutes=5 as assumed with DL38.
owner_role: Solution architect with the reference data owner
proposed: Fix the load on POST /api/recovery/partner/v1/admin/reference-loads with the table code partner_user and an Idempotency-Key, map each refusal condition to the legacy message id at its legacy status, take the partner_user fields from DF-REF-212 to DF-REF-217, and keep the five-minute refresh as an assumed parameter.
